\caption{Census of the exploratory interval estimates of amendments 2 to 10 (amendment 11, item B8): every estimate with a 95\,\% interval in the verification outputs v36 to v67, collected by key rules and counted once where the same value appears in several files. Distance-band and logit coefficients, near-minus-far contrasts, intervals that are not finite or inverted, and fits that separate are excluded, and so are the controls (records of surface water, recurrence, oracles and hazard maps). Excludes: the interval excludes the no-effect value (one for odds ratios, zero otherwise). The estimates are strongly dependent (many are variants of the same quantity). The first pass counted the excluded coefficients as name effects; the rules were refined before any count was used. The odds ratios within 500\,m of settlements are those of every estimate whose key or record names a near-settlement quantity; the first version of this census flagged them by the key alone and missed 93 of them (an implementation error corrected in addendum~1 of amendment 12). The $q$ values are approximate: they are computed from $p$ values recovered from asymmetric intervals, and the estimates are not independent. The machine-readable list is v69\_estimates.csv in the public repository.}\label{tab:eleven-census}
